title: Puchu Manqhat apst’ata
intro: Mä wayna alman saräwipax mä ch’aman visionampiw qalltawayi, alaxpachankir cuerponakax respetompiw qunqurt’asipxi. Aka jaqin jakäwipanx jak’ankirinakax wali aljantataw uñjasipxi, ukatx walja maranakaw esclavot uñjasipxi ukat jan wali carcelar jist’antataw uñjasipxi. Ukampis jan mayjtʼir iyawsäwimpi ukat Diosan irpäwipampixa, uka jaqix jukʼamp jiskʼa pʼiyatwa sartasïna, ukhamatwa mä jachʼa imperionkir wali chʼamani jaqinakat maynïr tukuwayi. ¿Allah-an aka muspharkañ luqtiripax khitïpachas uk yatxatasmati?
clues: Tunka mayan warawaranaka, inti ukat phaxsi nayraqatajan qunqurt’asis mä vision uñacht’ayapxitu
Awk taykajan wali munat wawapätwa, ukatwa jilanakajajj envidiasipjjäna
Jilanakajaw katuntapxitäna, isinak apsusipxitäna, ukat mä ch'amaka phuch'uruw jaquntapxäna
Mä qhatun mä aljañjam aljapxitäna ukat markajat jayaruw apapxitäna
Mä chʼamani warmiw jachʼañchatäñaj jan waltʼayañ munäna, ukat nayrar sartañap jan munataj laykuw carcelar jistʼantapjjetäna
Nayax samkanak qhanañchañ churäwimp bendicitätwa, ukat mä armat katuntat jaqit Egipto markan jilïr ministruparuw sartawayta

trial.label: Yant’awi/Evento
options: Mä manqhankir phuch'uruw mayni jilatanakan jaquntatäna
Uraqpachan jachʼa uma jalsut qhespiña
Mä nina nakhaskir hornoruw jaquntatäña

Jach’a challwampi manq’antatäña
trial.answer: Mä manqhankir phuch'uruw mayni jilatanakan jaquntatäna

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
options: Wasaran mä manqha, waña phuju
Mä jachʼa lawat lurat arcajj mä qollu patjjankiwa
Mä thujru, ukax mä katariruw tukuwayi
Mä jachʼa tronojj wali kʼajkirïnwa
Mä sling ukat phisqa llamp’u qalanaka

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Egipto markan jilïr ministrupäjjänwa ukat munat familiapampiw mayamp jikisjjäna
Mä jach’a barco luratayna ukat jaqinakar iyawsäwir jawsatayna
Mä taqpach markaruw Egipto markan esclavot mistuñapatak irpäna
Mä reino ukat jan uñjkañ yänak apnaqañ churapxäna
Sinti usunak tuqiw paciencia churasïna ukat qullatäxänwa
outcome.answer: Egipto markan jilïr ministrupäjjänwa ukat munat familiapampiw mayamp jikisjjäna

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
